= Delete a folder

[.api-doc-operation .api-doc-operation-delete]#DELETE# [.api-doc-code-block]#`/folders/{folder_id}`#



Deletes the specified folder.


== Parameters

[cols=5*,options=header]
|===
|Name
|Type
|In
|Required
|Description

|folder_id
|string
|path
|True
a|ID of the folder.

* example: 666a3f38-d4fa-5b62-a391-a69029758d32


|===

== Response

```
Status: 204, Indicates if the folder was deleted.
```

== Error

```
Status: 400, Bad request
```


[cols=4*,options=header]
|===
|Name
|Type
|Required
|Description

|status
|string
|True
a|HTTP error code related to the problem.


|title
|string
|True
a|Title description of the problem.


|===
